title: Picnic

scenario.title: Lists in notifications
scenario.body: "Ana, Ben, and Cleo are coming" is built from what people type: blank form fields, stray spaces, the same name twice, capitals and accents. The book sorts with plain sorted(), so "Banana" comes before "apple" and "éclairs" after "zucchini". Make the list read right without breaking any of the author's tests.

character.name: Pip
character.role: an ant who packs the picnic basket

tagline: Pip the ant packs the picnic basket and tells everyone what's in it. Add some food and listen to how Pip says the list.

brain_blurbs.book: Joins the words with commas and "and", exactly as typed.
brain_blurbs.real: Tidies the list first: no blanks, no repeats, sorted like a dictionary.

rules.test_usage: Explains itself when you ask for help (or bring nothing)
rules.test_two: Two things get an "and" in the middle
rules.test_more_than_two: Three or more get commas, and a comma before "and"
rules.test_two_sorted: Can sort two things into ABC order
rules.test_more_than_two_sorted: Can sort a long list into ABC order
rules.test_sort_ignores_capitals: A capital letter doesn't jump to the front of the line
rules.test_sort_ignores_accents: "éclairs" goes with the e's, not after z
rules.test_blank_items_are_skipped: Empty boxes don't turn into empty spots in the list
rules.test_repeats_listed_once: Chips and Chips is just chips
rules.test_items_with_commas_use_semicolons: When a thing has its own comma, the list uses semicolons so it isn't confusing
rules.test_nothing_to_bring: Only empty boxes? Pip says something's wrong
rules.test_tidy_lists_unchanged: The book's tidy lists still sound the same
